title: Graviton Photoproduction by a Kerr-Newman Black Hole with Worldline EFT
summary: We present the first computation of the gauge-invariant, long-wavelength scattering amplitude for the graviton photoproduction by a Kerr-Newman black hole through $\mathcal{O}\big((ωm)^2\big)$, or correspondingly $\mathcal{O}(S^2)$, and to linear order in $G$, using the worldline effective field theory. We show that electromagnetic interactions can be introduced consistently into the spinning worldline theory while preserving spin gauge invariance.
